intro: Lebanon is famous for its food, music and lively cultural life.

chapters.title: Music and writing
text: The singer Fairuz is loved across the Arab world. Khalil Gibran's The Prophet is one of the best-selling poetry books ever.

chapters.title: Food
text: Mezze, a spread of small dishes like hummus, tabbouleh, fattoush and kibbeh, is a Lebanese speciality. Manakish flatbread with za'atar is a classic breakfast.

keyTerms.meaning: A selection of small shared dishes.
